name: Joint Special Meeting - Planning Commission & Parks and Recreation Commission
agenda_text:
NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that a Special Meeting of the Planning Commission is hereby called to be held on THURSDAY, MARCH 3, 2022 at 7:00 p.m. at the Azusa Auditorium, located at 213 E. Foothill Blvd, Azusa, California 91702.
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA
If you cannot attend or wish not to attend the meeting. You may email your comment to publiccomment@azusca.gov before 6:30 PM on March 3, 2022.
A)
CALL TO ORDER
B)
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
C)
ROLL CALL
D)
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION - (Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption up to five (5) minutes in compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or response to questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her comments).
E)
STUDY SESSION
1.
Case No.: DR-2021-07, DR-2021-08 and TTM 083344 Location: 807 E. Promenade, Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8625-005-026 & 8625-005-027
Applicant: Rosedale Land Partners II, LLC
Project Name: Azusa Great Park and Residential Project
Study Session to analyze the development of 23 residential units and new community park located in the Rosedale Community within the Promenade District of the Monrovia Nursery Specific Plan (MNSP). The residential project would be located between The Promenade, Azusa Veterans Ways and Rosedale Avenue and adjacent to the proposed Great Park located to the north of the parcel.
3-3-22 - PC and PRC Staff Report - Rosedale Park Residential Study Session
Item E-1 - Exhibit A - Site Design of Park and Residential Project
Item E-1 - Exhibit B - Residential Project Architectural Plans
Item E-1 - Exhibit C - Community Survey
Item E-1 - Exhibit D - Timeline of Project Submittal and Park Amenity Outreach
F)
ADJOURNMENT
Except as specifically provided, public hearing items are appealable to the
City Council in accordance with the provisions of the City Code.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the Economic and Community Development Department - Planning Division, (626) 812-5235
Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 35.102.104 ADA Title II).
